name: intl.garena.com
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But images must have alternative text.
lesson: Describe what each image shows in its alt attribute, and use alt="" on purely decorative ones.
summary: intl.garena.com scores 51 out of 100 (F). 12 checks fail now, 34 are at risk, and 31 pass. Fix first: images must have alternative text.

fix.title: Images must have alternative text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 4 elements on /, for example .card.introduction-card-item[data-v-6fbe490c=""]:nth-child(2) > .card-swiper[data-v-ee00b8ef=""] > .swiper.swiper-initia and .swiper-slide-next.swiper-slide[data-swiper-slide-index="2"] >…
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. Missing on all 3 pages analyzed. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: All touch targets must be 24px large, or leave sufficient space
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 12 elements on /, /gpc/, /faq/, for example .content-group.footer-list-group[data-v-4d1103fd=""]:nth-child(1) > ul > li:nth-child(1) > a[target="_blank"][data-v-cad and .content-group.footer-list-group[data-v-4d1103fd=""]:nth-child(1) >…
fix.fix: Make tap targets at least 24 by 24 px, or leave that much space around them.

fix.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 31 elements on /, /gpc/, /faq/, for example p and a[href$="home"]. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text 3:1.

fix.title: The viewport stops people from zooming
fix.evidence: The viewport tag sets user-scalable=no or maximum-scale=1.
fix.fix: Remove user-scalable=no and maximum-scale from the viewport tag.

fix.title: Tracking starts on load and no banner asks first
fix.evidence: No cookie banner appeared. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw Google Analytics (6 requests), and cookies _ga, _ga_G3FBKF6PP0, _ga_0CFEMJV44G.
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
Images below the first screen wait until they are needed
Every page has a meta description
